item.title: The Technology That Centers You with Steven Schrembeck | 79
item.description:
Send us Fan Mail

The Grateful Podcast with Jack Wagoner
Episode 79
Guesting Stephen Schrembeck

What if the next frontier of human connection isn’t less tech—but better tech?

In this mind-opening episode of The Grateful Podcast, Jack Wagoner sits down with Stephen Schrembeck, founder of Impossible Labs, to explore how we can redesign technology to deepen presence, amplify our humanity, and support mental well-being.

Stephen shares how his personal experience with ADHD and a lifetime of reflection sparked a movement to reimagine how we use tech—from minimalist wearable tools like Cognizant Threads to powerful mental models for focus, meditation, and emotional resilience. They dive deep into the philosophy of building from curiosity, the power of silence, dopamine rebalancing, and how to stay grounded while pursuing meaningful, ambitious goals.

Whether you’re an entrepreneur, thinker, creative, or someone feeling overstimulated by modern life—this episode is a must-listen.

⸻

🎯 What We Cover:
 • Why “less tech” isn’t the solution—but better tech is
 • How Stephen manages ADHD without distraction
 • The story behind Impossible Labs and designing for the edge
 • Tools for extending focus, attention, and presence
 • How meditation reshaped his mind (and why it matters more than meds)
 • Why boredom is actually the antidote to overstimulation
 • The chair test: can you sit in silence for 5 minutes?
 • How to create while staying unburdened by outcome
 • The duality of ambition and stillness—and how to hold both

⸻
